summary.intent: Review, verify, and ship three parallel subagent implementations for the callisto repo (versioned-not-published PR line, skipping private npm workspace roots, and did-you-mean suggestions for package names), including changesets, PRs, and trail links.
summary.outcome: All three branches were reviewed, fixed where needed, committed signed, pushed, linked to trails, and opened as draft PRs #487, #490, #491 with local checks passing; PR-body and cold-read changeset agents were still running.

repo: Release PR bodies now include a 'Versioned, not published' line via PublishOutlook::Planned.versioned_only (serde default + skip_serializing_if empty, schema version unchanged so old stored previews still load).
Callisto verification uses a verify.sh script with lint/doc-check/test/pre-push steps; tests run via cargo nextest, and test logs show FAIL lines per test.

Skipping a private npm workspace root (one listing workspaces) unless a [[package]] block names it broke test fixtures that relied on the root being a package; fixtures in init tests and npm_platform_packages_test.rs had to be adjusted.
The existing Cargo 'no version' note is printed on every command that loads the workspace, so the new private-root skip note repeats similarly (e.g., multiple times during init).
Docs spec docs/specs/release.json (REL-PR-10) and docs/architecture/versioning.md document release preview behavior and must be kept in sync with changes.
Every PR in this repo needs a changeset file under .changeset/ and a trail link via `entire trail link <id> --branch ... --base main`.

code.finding: publish_outlook_in loops over preview.packages once, planning packages passing has_dispatchable_target and putting the rest in versioned_only; Blocked outlook passes through untouched.
publish_section renders the versioned-only line directly after the publish table, before the _note_ lines, and also when nothing publishes.
unsupported_workspace_skips_workflow_generation_with_a_json_diagnostic failed because of the private-root rule, not the sandbox; its fixture root was incidental and was edited.

workflow: Subagent claims that failures are 'sandbox-related' should be verified by rerunning outside the sandbox and comparing to main; here one of four was actually a real regression.
Run a pairwise overlap check across parallel PR branches (and against open PRs) before opening them.
Run real-repo end-to-end scripts to confirm user-visible output rather than relying only on unit tests.
`entire trail link` right after a push can fail with 'branch does not exist'; waiting a few seconds and retrying with the same idempotency key worked.
Use a cold-read agent with only the changeset text to catch vagueness before human review.

friction: Subagent reported four test failures as sandbox-related without confirming against main; one was a genuine regression from the new rule.
Subagent's `git switch -c` appeared to leave it on the old branch, causing confusion about the branch state.
The full cargo test run stops at the first failing binary, and the --no-fail-fast run's exit code was lost to backgrounding.
entire trail link failed for #491 with 'branch does not exist' immediately after the push.
`gh pr diff` redirect into the jobs tmp dir initially needed a rerun with absolute paths.
open_items: Deduplicate the skip/no-version notes so they print once per command rather than every workspace load (affects the private-root note and the existing Cargo note).
Collect and apply results from the three PR-body agents and the cold-read changeset agent.
CI has not run on the three draft PRs.
Decide whether the 'Versioned, not published' line should go after the _note_ lines instead of before them.
The pr_body render test is not covered by the mutation check, and new tests were not run against pre-change code.
